string-array.name: tips
string-array.item: TIP · Two fingers tilt and turn the 3D camera.
TIP · Go live to put yourself on your circle\'s map.
TIP · Report a jam, a crash or a closed road with Report.
TIP · Inside a private place, your circle sees a blur, not you.
TIP · SOS shows your circle exactly where you are.
TIP · Tap somebody to see where they went today.
TIP · If the map moves, send /login to the bot again.

resources.string:
1 · In Telegram, send /login to your LiveGeo bot.
2 · Share the link it sends you to LiveGeo, or copy it and tap Paste link.

The link carries your map's address, and the app remembers it.
Its address changes when the server restarts. Send /login to the bot again and share the new link here.
The address is right, but the server behind it is not answering. Try again in a minute. If it keeps failing, send /login to the bot for a fresh link.
That link does not lead to a LiveGeo map, so the app did not keep it. In Telegram, send /login to your LiveGeo bot, then share or paste the link it sends: that one has /auth/ in it.
This device is offline. Try again when it is back.
No map link there. Copy the link the bot sent you first.
Only an https:// address can be your map.
Your circle will see where you were last, not where you are.
